programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Tighten the Screws
programme.desc: When young Iraq War veteran Curtis Ashley ends up dead, Lt. Joe Kenda has to solve the slaying of a seemingly innocent victim using his keen awareness of the criminal mind.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threaten to derail the case, Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fate Worst Than Death
programme.desc: At the bottom of a steep ravine, joggers discover a body mutilated beyond recognition. To catch a ruthless maniac, Lt. Joe Kenda must first solve the puzzle of the victim’s identity.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My, My, Merry Christmas
programme.desc: Donald Ott is found shot to death, friends tell police he didn’t have an enemy in the world. But when Lt. Joe Kenda speaks with family, he learns of a relative who might hold the key to the mystery.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Killer Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: When 22 year-old Micki Filmore is found raped and murder in her apartment, detective Kenda focuses his investigation on her activities the previous night.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Good Doctor
programme.desc: A single mother in Saskatchewan visits a hospital in the midst of a panic attack. Her doctor sedates her. Then, she is certain, he rapes her.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Sweet Killer
programme.desc: An aging hippy is going through bad times. When he's found dead in his home with a gut of antifreeze, it's a closed case. Then a shocking confession reveals a maelstrom of lies and a story of cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Stranger
programme.desc: Bored at home, a retiree takes a job at a 24-hour convenience store. On her third night at work a customer finds her behind the register in a pool of blood.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hunted
programme.desc: A real estate broker doesn’t return home. Her family can't find her. But police do - dead in a closet in her office. The DNA on her body is tested against 150 men. No match. The case runs cold.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Predator
programme.desc: The phone rings in the middle of the night. On the other end of the line, the sounds of an attack. The couple that receive the call rush to its source and discover a horrific scene.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Evil Eyes
programme.desc: A dead woman is found in a park. It’s learned the deceased is a divorced landlady of a group home for transients. The suspect list is long; the clues to follow are few.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Lust
programme.desc: One morning in the stairwell of a Toronto building, a guard makes a grotesque discovery: the dead body of a Filipina nanny. It's clear she's been savagely murdered and raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Model Killer
programme.desc: A gorgeous young model is bludgeoned to death in her downtown apartment. The wounds to her head are so severe police initially presume she's been shot.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Dead End
programme.desc: A young couple hits the road, hitchhiking across North America. Free spirits keen to explore the world. When the young woman stops phoning home, her father is alarmed.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Bull's Eye
programme.desc: A Girl Guide leader is found dead on the floor of her bedroom. When an autopsy reveals a bullet lodged in her brain, detectives learn they’re investigating a murder.

programme.title: iCarly: Ångra dagen
programme.desc: Spencer räddar livet på sångaren i The Plain White T's och får honom att gå med på att vara med i iCarly. Underliga saker börjar gå fel mitt i Carlys, Sams och Freddies webbsändning.

programme.title: iCarly: Kvarsittning
programme.desc: Sam får kvarsittning samma kväll som det är iCarlys spektakulära, femtionde webbshow. Eftersom de inte kan göra sin planerade webbshow, gör Carly och Freddie sitt bästa för att också få kvarsittning, så att de kan göra showen på kvarsittningen.

programme.title: iCarly: Skoskav
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie blir inbjudna till Dakas huvudkontor, där de blir erbjudna en stor summa pengar för att rekommendera Dakas nya sko, Tech-Foot, på iCarly. Men skon visar sig vara fruktansvärd.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag lovar att inte berätta
programme.desc: Carly får betyget B på en historieuppsats hon borde ha fått ett A på. Sam ser sin chans under sitt veckomöte med rektor Franklin, och ändrar Carlys betyg i datorn och överraskar henne med flera A.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly räddar TV
programme.desc: En höjdar-producent vill förvandla iCarly till en TV-show. Men Carly, Sam och Freddie blir snabbt upprörda när de får höra talas om alla de stora ändringar som TV-producenten vill göra.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag hatar Sams pojkvän
programme.desc: Sam skaffar pojkvän, och de båda är oskiljaktiga. Men när förhållandet börjar påverka iCarly, inser Carly och Freddie att de måste göra något åt det.

programme.title: iCarly: Övervakning
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett ett inslag på iCarly som visade en man som säljer olagliga filmkopior, bestämmer sig två poliser för att använda Carlys och Spencers våning som en övervakningsplats.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag kanske byter skola
programme.desc: Carly får veta att hon på grund av sin webbshow, kan få möjlighet till ett heltäckande stipendium till den privata elitskolan Briarwood. Carly är inte så sugen på det, men Sam och Freddie vet att de måste få henne att ändra sig.

programme.title: iCarly: Fart och fäkt
programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: Trump: What's The Deal
programme.desc: Dokumentär om Donald Trumps tidiga affärer, kontroverser och hur han byggde sitt imperium genom tvivelaktiga metoder.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: Love and Betrayal

programme.title: Wandering Wolves: Episode 2
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe.

programme.title: On the Case: The Killer Rang Twice
programme.desc: Linda Donahew, of Arlington Texas, was discovered stabbed to death by her sister one night in June. For nearly two decades the case remained unsolved, until detectives matched DNA from Linda's case with another case a few hundred miles away.

programme.title: On the Case: Footsteps in the Dark
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman's is murdered in a dark parking lot. Did she know her killer or was she the victim of a deadly predator?

programme.title: On the Case: 22 Hours of Terror
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is kidnapped during a home invasion, and police frantically search for her and her abductor. Paula Zahn explores the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery, Heartbreak and Justice
programme.desc: A look at three cases in which the quest for justice rages on after the verdict has been delivered.

programme.title: On the Case: Same Crime Next Year
programme.desc: A teenager is found murdered on the weekend of the Daytona 500 motor race in Daytona Beach, Florida. Then, one year later, police are called to the scene of a nearly identical crime.

programme.title: On the Case: The Doorbell Rang
programme.desc: The ring of a doorbell overheard during a teenager's final telephone call may be the key to solving her murder.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Finish Line
programme.desc: A multi-stop mission to the Far North has Devan, Scott and Adam facing a series of white- knuckle obstacles.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ski Plane
programme.desc: Young pilots AJ and Andrew get the chance of a lifetime to fly the magnificent DC-3 specially equipped with skis to land on frozen strips.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Buffalo Scores
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North. Cup fever spreads quickly around Buffalo, and for Mikey, what begins as an innocent love for this hockey icon soon becomes an obsession.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Chief Pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck goes one-on-one with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour with the newest member of the McBryan family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Yukon
programme.desc: When thunderstorms and a shaking engine threaten a DC-3 charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: "The Witches" Star Stanley Tucci, "Hubie Halloween" Star Noah Schnapp
programme.desc: Drew continues the week-long Halloween celebration with "The Witches" star Stanley Tucci. Leo Kelly joins to make a mocktail. "Hubie Halloween" star Noah Schnapp stops by to chat. Plus, Design by Drew Scarrymore and the Drew Scarrymore Costume Challenge.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew’s Never Have I Ever Hour, First Date After Divorce
programme.desc: It’s Drew’s Never Have I Ever Hour! Drew helps a viewer get ready for her first date since her divorce. New foods with Eitan Bernath. Then, we follow a couple as they go sky diving for the first time! Plus bonus moments with actress Charlize Theron.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Dr. Phil, "Hubie Halloween" Star China Anne McClain, Drew’s News with Ross Matthews
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares why it was important for him to produce his new docuseries "That Animal Rescue Show." Then, Halloween week continues with "Hubie Halloween" star China Anne McClain. Plus, Drew’s News with special guest Ross Matthews.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Anne Hathaway, "The Daily Show’s” Dulce Sloan
programme.desc: Week-long Halloween celebration w/ "The Witches" star Anne Hathaway. "The Daily Show's" Dulce Sloan introduces some single men & their furry sidekicks! Drew goes down to the basement of the CBS Studios with ghosthunter Steve Gonsalves to hunt for ghosts!

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew’s Halloween Show! "Emily in Paris" Star Ashley Park
programme.desc: Drew’s Halloween show! "Emily in Paris's" Ashley Park stops by. Plus, celebrations expert Darcy Miller shares tips to repurpose leftover Halloween candy. Drew's "Stans for Stains: Halloween Edition." A curated list of Drew's favorites in "The Weekender."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jessica Capshaw, Rage Baking
programme.desc: Netflix’s "Holidate" star Jessica Capshaw stops by to chat. Then, Drew enlists finance expert Farnoosh Torabi and psychologist Dr. Aliza Pressman who share tips on how to talk to your kids about money. Drew and Ross Matthews try-out "Rage Baking."

programme.title: 48 Hours: Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Kalamazoo, Michigan's cold case unit's investigation of the September 1994 disappearance of Khristine Smith, a seemingly happy wife and mother.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Why Did Josh Kill?
programme.desc: Eight-year-old Maddie Clifton of Jacksonville, Florida went outside to play and never came back. Seven days later a city-wide search led to the home of Josh Phillips, a 14-year-old neighbor, where Maddie's body was found under the boy's waterbed.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Imposter
programme.desc: A report about an elusive con man David Pecard, who has taken on more than 20 identities throughout his life of crime. Pecard has infiltrated police departments and top military posts, put criminals behind bars and even posed as a technician.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Family's Shame
programme.desc: The broadcast presents accounts of people who suffer the reality that a close relative has committed murder and endure the struggle between family ties and civic responsibility.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Justice For Sheila?
programme.desc: This report offers fresh insight into the brutal murder of Sheila Bellush, a Sarasota, Florida mother of quadruplets who was killed in front of her children.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in L.A.
programme.desc: Focuses on two California couples: the Adairs and the Shapiros. Mindy Shapiro discovered that her husband Michael, an orthopedic surgeon, was having an affair with Jeanie Adair, and in 1996, after 11 years of marriage, the couple opted for divorce.

programme.title: COPS: The Naked Truth
programme.desc: An evasive driver blames his girlfriend for his behavior, a pregnant woman makes some questionable choices, and a robbery suspect finds comfort in coming clean.

programme.title: COPS: Rock Star
programme.desc: Officers intervene when a dispute between neighbors gets heated, suspects of a shooting lead police on a high-speed pursuit, and a domestic argument gets out of hand.

programme.title: COPS: Window of Opportunity
programme.desc: Officers apprehend an armed suspect, the cops are called when a man damages his neighbor's window, and deputies investigate a parking garage known for illegal activity.

programme.title: COPS: Mommy's Tears
programme.desc: A suspect collides with another driver while fleeing from police, deputies mediate an altercation over a bag of chips, and officers respond to a domestic dispute.

programme.title: COPS: Running Scared
programme.desc: Suspected jewelry thieves attempt a daring escape during a pursuit, a man gives officers a challenge during his arrest, and a traffic stop puts a marriage in jeopardy.

programme.title: COPS: Time to Climb
programme.desc: A couple flee a routine traffic stop. An intoxicated woman climbs a tree. Construction workers are pulled over for a hand-to-hand transaction.

programme.title: COPS: Dine and Flee
programme.desc: A sting operation is set up to catch narcotics dealers. A man flees a restaurant without paying his four-hundred-dollar tab. A traffic stop for a tint violation leads to a felony arrest for narcotics.

programme.title: COPS: Gas up and Run!
programme.desc: A man is tasered twice after struggling with two deputies. A gas station fight ends in a foot chase. A deputy pulls over a pair of quarreling lovers after they run a stop sign.

programme.title: COPS: Settled with a Pipe
programme.desc: A man attacking a woman is tackled by an officer. A vehicle is pulled over for a drug deal in progress. A woman smashes a car window with a pipe in a fit of road rage.

programme.title: COPS: Dyed in the Wool
programme.desc: A suspect selling narcotics takes off on foot. A bank robber leaves his wallet in an abandoned money bag. Multiple domestic violence calls end in arrests.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell Case
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains. Taken to hospital, the couple die several days apart. The food poisoning theory is quickly ruled out and forensic tests show the Labrells were poisoned with arsenic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 301
programme.desc: Under 2018 kommer justitieminister Tor Mikkel Wara att utsättas för flera allvarliga attacker mot sitt hem. Polisen står utan ledtrådar. Snart är dock skandalen ett faktum när polisen misstänker hans sambo.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: När 32-årige Memo plötsligt försvinner tar hans vänner saken i egna händer och börjar desperat leta efter honom. Deras oro förvandlas till ren skräck när deras sökande leder till oroande upptäckter.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Den 12 juni 2017 hittas ett äldre par brutalt mördade och tejpade hemma på sin gård utanför Mantorp. För att lösa mordet måste mordutredarna nu använda sig av noggrant polisarbete i klass med CSI.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: I 2006 brinner Barbro Karlssons och Bertil Sandins hus på norra Öland ner till grunden. I brandresterna hittas parets kvarlevor. Rädslan för den mordiska pyromanen som går lös sprider skräck på Öland.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Tina Jørgensen försvann efter en natt ute i Stavanger. En månad senare hittar polisen kroppen av en 20-årig kvinna. Vem mördade Tina och sedan dumpade henne längs en öde väg?

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: En ensamvarg som bestämt sig för att mörda. Under 2018 och 2019 begår 20-åringen flera överfall mot personer på promenad i Sollentuna. Upprymd över vad han gjort ringer han till SOS för att skryta.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst är i Linköping och hjälper polisen att klara upp en misshandel som ägde rum utanför en studentpub. Vi får även se övervakningsfilmen från det hatbrott som drabbade RFSL Sjuhärad i Borås.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: I somras blev en ung tjej attackerad av sin expojkvän och hans kompisar på Strandvägen. Vi besöker också Cornell Bailey, som fått sin foodtruck i centrala Sundbyberg vandaliserad i ett års tid.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Polisen har bett Efterlyst om hjälp kring en grov misshandel som filmades av ett gäng och att ta fast en vapenkurir. Dessutom presenteras den första nomineringen till årets Civilkuragepris.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst fortsätter att hjälpa polisen i Stockholm att klara upp avrättningen på 74-årige Curre Sederström. Dessutom konfronteras AI-bedragare som lurar desperata hundägare med krav på lösensumma.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst rapporterar bland annat om misstänkta försök till människorov på barn i Täby och Vallentuna, en fräck stöld i Nykvarn som fångades på kamera, och om en 18-åring som sköts till döds i Gävle.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2509

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 3106

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2406

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2504
programme.desc: Therese, 34 år, från Svalöv skyller gärna sina skulder på yttre omständigheter. Det senaste året har hon bränt 123 616 kronor på Ullared, cigaretter, godis och sina 13 marsvin.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2302
programme.desc: Hästuppfödaren Jesper från Lindesberg har skulder på 100 000-tals kronor slösar pengar på bara skräp. När ekonomiexperterna föreslår en försäljning av hästarna slutar det med hot om polisanmälan.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2807
programme.desc: Emelies problem eskalerade för fem år sen då hon och sonens pappa separerade och Emilie fick så dålig ekonomi att hon inte såg någon annan utväg än att börja spela på nätcasinon för att få in pengar.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 106
programme.desc: En valp ska få ett nytt hem och Natalie förbereder försäljningen. Hon är noga med vem som tar sig an valpen och attt den ska komma till ett kärleksfullt hem. Knappt hinner valpen iväg innan en olycka händer.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 107

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 108
programme.desc: Madde och Isaacs bebis tillbringar sina första dagar i livet på sjukhuset. Hon fick andningssvårigheter efter förlossningen på grund av fostervatten i lungorna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 109
programme.desc: Natalies kennel har blivit granskad av SKK och nu måste hon vidta en rad åtgärder. Om hon inte gör det så kommer de stänga ner kenneln innan veckan är slut. Men hon har ett tugnt jobb framför sig.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 110

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 111

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 115

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unga journalisten Tamara Drewe återvänder till sina rötter på den engelska landsbygden för att sälja sitt barndomshem efter att hennes mamma dött.

programme.title: Storfräsarna

programme.title: Boomerang: Love Shoulda Brought You Home

programme.title: Games People Play: Persons of Interests

programme.desc: Laila hamnar i en farlig situation. MJ hör rykten om att nån läcker uppgifter om familjen King. Vanessas familj hotas och hon bestämmer att det är dags att agera.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2502

programme.desc: When strange, almost paranormal happenings are observed at a decommissioned air base, the spooky occurrences take on a decidedly different tone when the team is brought in to investigate the mystery of a dead woman found there.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: iCarly: Fart och fäkt
programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en dejt
programme.desc: När deras vän Gibby är för blyg för att bjuda ut en tjej han gillar, bestämmer sig gänget för att göra honom och föremålet för hans kärlek till tävlande i ett "Vinn en dejt"-inslag i sin webbshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag såg honom först
programme.desc: När Carly och Sam blir intresserade av samma kille, lovar de att det inte ska komma emellan deras vänskap. Det här visar sig bli svårare än de trott och snart prövas deras vänskap medan de håller på och tävlar om hans uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: iCarly: Beroendeframkallande
programme.desc: Carly måste ingripa när Spencer blir spelberoende. Sam lurar Freddie att tro att han har drabbats av otur bara för att han vägrade skicka vidare ett kedje-email.

programme.title: iCarly: Lånet
programme.desc: Sam blir förolämpad när Freddie anklagar henne för att inte betala tillbaka pengarna hon ständigt lånar av honom och Carly. Sam försöker allt hon kan komma på för att kunna betala tillbaka; till och med ett riktigt jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Driva med Lewbert"-sketch går förskräckligt fel och skadar Carlys oförskämde portvakt. Gänget vårdar honom tills dess att Freddies mamma kommer in och tar över. När en romans börjar spira måste de sätta stopp för den.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Spencer tar med Freddie till sin favorit-pajställe, får de veta att ägaren har avlidit. Ännu värre; det verkar som om hans recept har gått förlorade för alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: En normal jul
programme.desc: I ett försök att krydda julfirandet med en ovanlig julgran, råkar Spencer av misstag sätta eld på alla Carlys julklappar. Ursinnigt önskar hon att hon hade en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil
programme.desc: Gänget kör en tävling på iCarly; priset är en ny bil tack vare en lokal bilfirma. Efter att Nevel vunnit, upptäcker ungdomarna att bilfirman inte kände till tävlingen eller gratis-bilen som de påstods ha donerat till tävlingen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred
programme.desc: Freddie säger under en sändning att han inte är ett fan av internetsensationen Fred, vilket får Fred att meddela att han tänker sluta att lägga ut filmer för alltid. Fansen blir rasande för att Freddie har orsakat slutet för de populära filmerna.

programme.title: My Family and The Galapagos: Episode 1
programme.desc: Monty Halls and family return to the Galapagos to aid a Giant Tortoise study and Tam goes in search of Giant Manta Rays.

programme.title: Ocean Stories: Dolphins and Whales
programme.desc: Dolphin expert Ute Margreff and wildlife film-maker Florian Graner share with us their passionate interest in these inhabitants of our oceans.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany and their wild inhabitants are world famous. Forests enters a world full of magic.

programme.title: On the Case: The Doorbell Rang
programme.desc: The ring of a doorbell overheard during a teenager's final telephone call may be the key to solving her murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Over The Edge
programme.desc: Police are called to the scene of what appears to be a tragic car wreck in the Blue Ridge Mountains... But as Investigators examine the crash site they realize Wendy Kratzert's death was no accident.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger's Knock
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a house fire they discover a woman shot and killed inside. Police must unlock the mystery of who started the blaze to solve the murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Hanging By A Thread
programme.desc: Hillsborough County Florida is in the midst of a horrifying crime spree. Young women are turning up dead every week. Can one teen age girl's bravery bring an end to a vicious killer's reign of terror?

programme.title: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
programme.desc: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dambusters
programme.desc: Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business when veteran pilot Arnie flies the DC-4 for the re- enactment scene of a famous WWII bombing raid.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Chuck Walks
programme.desc: Critical of the many stops and starts in the Electra program, and frustrated with the constant drama at Buffalo, Chuck quits. Joe clashes with the maintenance department when a series of delays puts the sale of an old Canso waterbomber in jeopardy.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jessica Capshaw, Rage Baking
programme.desc: Netflix’s "Holidate" star Jessica Capshaw stops by to chat. Then, Drew enlists finance expert Farnoosh Torabi and psychologist Dr. Aliza Pressman who share tips on how to talk to your kids about money. Drew and Ross Matthews try-out "Rage Baking."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Actress Annaleigh Ashford, Olympic Snowboarder Jamie Anderson
programme.desc: Actress Annaleigh Ashford chats. Drew has a big surprise for nurse Gina Goodwin, who cooks and delivers hundreds of meals every Thanksgiving. Olympic snowboarder Jamie Anderson shares her winter skin routine. Drew reads letters in "Dear Drew."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Youtube Star David Dobrik, Comedian Fortune Feimster, Beauty Backgrounder
programme.desc: David Dobrik on amassing over 15 million YouTube subscribers and the Vlog Squad. Comedian Fortune Feimster stops by. in Beauty Backgrounder, Drew does a deep-dive into the history of iconic beauty looks and shares tips for perfecting the timeless look.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Comedian Gabriel Iglesias, "Friendsgiving" Cast
programme.desc: Host of Nickelodeon’s new animal talent show "Unleashed" comedian Gabriel Iglesias shares with Drew one of his favorite acts. Cast of the new film "Friendsgiving" including Malin Akerman, Kat Dennings, Aisha Tyler and Chelsea Peretti stop by to chat.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Wildflower: Model Winnie Harlow, Mom’s Time Out
programme.desc: Drew spotlights women in signature "Wildflower." Laura Sobiech and Director Justin Baldoni discuss her son Zach’s battle with cancer inspiring a number one song. In "Mom’s Time Out," Drew surprises one deserving mom with an all-expenses paid vacation!

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in L.A.
programme.desc: Focuses on two California couples: the Adairs and the Shapiros. Mindy Shapiro discovered that her husband Michael, an orthopedic surgeon, was having an affair with Jeanie Adair, and in 1996, after 11 years of marriage, the couple opted for divorce.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Enemy Within
programme.desc: An investigation of the murder of Vicki Robinson, a 49-year-old divorced Florida real estate agent, and the role of her 15-year-old daughter, Valessa in the crime.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Heroes Under Fire
programme.desc: A fire that ignited in an abandoned warehouse in Worcester, Massachusetts in 1999, claimed the lives of six firefighters. A homeless couple living in the building, were subsequently charged with manslaughter for starting the blaze.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Citizen Jane
programme.desc: When Gertrude McCabe was murdered, her niece Jane Alexander was named her principal beneficiary. Jane, a widow in her 70s, began to suspect that her live-in boyfriend, Tom O'Donnell, might have been involved in the crime.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Daddy's Little Girl
programme.desc: At 16 Mindy Berenyi, an Antwerp, Ohio girl claiming to be a victim of physical and psychological abuse, was tried for the murder of her father and, having agreed to a plea bargain, was sentenced to prison.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Accused
programme.desc: In 1996 the car which Sheila Bryan was driving with her mother as passenger accidentally veered off the road and into a ditch killing her mother. Sheila was charged with murder -- then tried, convicted, and sentenced to life imprisonment.

programme.title: COPS: Dyed in the Wool
programme.desc: A suspect selling narcotics takes off on foot. A bank robber leaves his wallet in an abandoned money bag. Multiple domestic violence calls end in arrests.

programme.title: COPS: The House Always Wins
programme.desc: A suspect runs from an illegal gambling game claiming shots were fired. A man is caught trespassing on school grounds. A male driver wearing a halter top is pulled over for a minor traffic violation.

programme.title: COPS: Allergy Season
programme.desc: A drunk driver rams into a pursuing police car. A man on a bike flees an area known for drug activity on a bike. A sniffling man attempts to hide a baggie with narcotics under his shirt.

programme.title: COPS: Yard Work
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a call of a man shooting a gun in his front yard. Officers are called to a domestic dispute over an wrinkly infant's shirt. Four armed and suspicious men are spotted by deputies.

programme.title: COPS: Keep it Down!
programme.desc: An officer is forced to subdue a suspect with his baton. A man asks deputies to give him back his drugs before taking him to jail. A man causes a disturbance at an apartment complex.

programme.title: COPS: Hot Potato
programme.desc: A man tosses his stash after being pulled over. Officers question two men in a fight who live with the same woman. A man says his shorts are from a thrift store after drugs are found in them.

programme.title: COPS: Nerves of Noodles
programme.desc: A man tells deputies the pants he has on aren't his. Officers are called to the scene of men firing an ak-47. A nervous driver fesses up to the deputy who stopped him.

programme.title: COPS: What's Your Deductible?
programme.desc: Detectives chase a suspect who wrecks his car. Police are called when a man headbutts his neighbor. Officers tend to a woman punched in the face by her husband while on the bus.

programme.title: COPS: Wardrobe Malfunction
programme.desc: A suspect flees police in a truck over a misdemeanor traffic warrant. A man denies hitting his wife who has a bloody nose. A man denies ownership of his shorts when deputies find drugs in them.

programme.title: COPS: High Speed Golf
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a truck with a trailer full of golf carts. Police question a driver after finding a mask and handgun in his car. Officers are called to a traffic collision involving a semi and an SUV.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Julein Thevenet Case
programme.desc: On January 27th 2014, in Somme-Suippe in the Marne, Sophie Thevenet discovers her dead husband's body in the garage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Émilie Godest Case
programme.desc: On November 9th 2007, around 11:30PM, aid arrives on the scene of an accident at the exit of Chateney-en-France.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.desc: On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: En ensamvarg som bestämt sig för att mörda. Under 2018 och 2019 begår 20-åringen flera överfall mot personer på promenad i Sollentuna. Upprymd över vad han gjort ringer han till SOS för att skryta.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 703
